summary: 账户侧两项改动：Gottfried Herold 提交 PR，让 EIP-8250 能区分一次性 nonce（如 nullifier）和普通序号 nonce；CPerezz 提交 EIP-8298 修订（24 日合并），允许在 initcode 中使用 SETCODEFROM，并要求源账户必须存在。EIP-7773 写入 Sepolia 激活时间。Gottfried Herold 另发帖勾勒不需要批量解密的门限 IBE 加密内存池。

items.title: ethresear.ch：基于无批量门限 IBE 的加密内存池
items.note: 23:09（GottfriedHerold）。受 LUCID 启发，一张类似 FOCIL 的票据先上链，把执行锁定到已知的未来区块；之后发送者以承载票据区块的哈希作为身份加密交易。不要求批量解密，可选的门限方案更多。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: towards encrypted mempools from threshold IBE without batching
items.note_en: 23:09 (GottfriedHerold). Inspired by LUCID, a FOCIL-like ticket lands onchain first and pins execution to a known future block; only then does the sender encrypt toward the hash of the ticket-carrying block as the identity. Batch decryption is not required, which widens the choice of threshold schemes.

keywords_en: EIP-7773 sets the Sepolia activation time
summary_en: Two account-side changes: Gottfried Herold submitted a PR letting EIP-8250 tell one-shot nonces (such as nullifiers) apart from ordinary sequence nonces, and CPerezz submitted an EIP-8298 revision (merged on the 24th) allowing SETCODEFROM in initcode and requiring the source account to exist. EIP-7773 recorded the Sepolia activation time. Gottfried Herold also sketched an encrypted mempool based on threshold IBE without batch decryption.
